in_marathi.name: Bansari
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bansari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bansari is a beautiful Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘Bans’. It refers to a bamboo grove, which is a place of peace, tranquility, and abundance. The name evokes images of lush green forests, gentle rustling of leaves, and the soothing sound of flowing water.
